title: Draw! with Sui - a webgame where you and an AI draw things
author: TurtLss
selftext:
Play here: [sei.gg/draw](http://sei.gg/draw)

A drawing-and-guessing webgame where you take turns with an AI who, for once, actually has to draw every stroke like we do. Design inspired by Google's Quick, Draw!. Hope it can make your day a little better!

How it works: the model outputs clean polylines using a pen tool with coordinates. A post-process pipeline humanizes the drawing by resampling the path, adding jitter, and animating it stroke-by-stroke. The humanized drawing is sent back to the AI for it to decide if it wants to add more detail, or clear and try again. I'll be open-sourcing the full codebase GitHub in the next few days.
